recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future VSD metadata changes should use a new tracker against the current ValueSet/MetadataResource model or the FHIR Extension Pack artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-3225 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked Vocab to change the FHIR-core ValueSet resource so its basic metadata aligned with the HL7 Value Set Definition Process.
initial_application: The historical application is git commit 2e2d1d98 from 2014-05-06, whose subject says it updated ValueSet as agreed with the Vocabulary committee by adding optional metadata elements, extensions for remaining VSD metadata, and a formal minimum metadata profile.
additional_context: Current XML source replaces the old spreadsheet source and ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini. Current ValueSet source and narrative explicitly document VSD alignment. Later FHIR-36015 added the current VSD guidance text, and later FHIR-35985 made ValueSet a MetadataResource with first-class metadata elements. Older VSD-specific extension artifacts now live in the FHIR Extension Pack, with replaced metadata extensions retired/deprecated there.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit was made because the current build-scope source already conveys the requested alignment and further edits would duplicate or reopen later decisions.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive Vocab issue added current ValueSet notes for VSD-aligned profile guidance and is already represented on the combined reconciliation branch.
